```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(knitr)
```

## Research Question

What are the key factors that influence the estimated construction cost of building permits in Toronto from 2017 to 2024?

## Load Dataset

```{r}
building_data <- read.csv("raw_building_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

## Clean and Transform Data

```{r}
# Convert EST_CONST_COST to numeric
building_data$EST_CONST_COST <- as.numeric(gsub(",", "", building_data$EST_CONST_COST))
# Filter out non-positive or missing EST_CONST_COST
building_data <- building_data[!is.na(building_data$EST_CONST_COST) & building_data$EST_CONST_COST > 0, ]
# Remove negative values in DWELLING_UNITS_CREATED and RESIDENTIAL
building_data <- building_data[building_data$DWELLING_UNITS_CREATED >= 0 & 
                               building_data$RESIDENTIAL >= 0, ]
# Select relevant columns
cleaned_data <- building_data[, c("EST_CONST_COST", "PERMIT_TYPE", "STRUCTURE_TYPE", 
                                  "WARD_GRID", "DWELLING_UNITS_CREATED", "RESIDENTIAL")]
# Drop any remaining NAs
cleaned_data <- na.omit(cleaned_data)
# Set baseline for PERMIT_TYPE
cleaned_data$PERMIT_TYPE <- relevel(as.factor(cleaned_data$PERMIT_TYPE), 
                                    ref = "Residential Building Permit")

```

## Save Cleaned Data

```{r}
write.csv(cleaned_data, "cleaned_building_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Summary Table of Predictors

```{r}
library(knitr)
# Summary of numerical variables
numeric_summary <- summary(cleaned_data[, c("EST_CONST_COST", "DWELLING_UNITS_CREATED", "RESIDENTIAL")])
kable(numeric_summary, caption = "Table 1. Summary statistics of numeric predictors used in the model.")
# Summary of categorical variables
top_permit <- head(sort(table(cleaned_data$PERMIT_TYPE), decreasing = TRUE), 5)
top_structure <- head(sort(table(cleaned_data$STRUCTURE_TYPE), decreasing = TRUE), 5)
top_ward <- head(sort(table(cleaned_data$WARD_GRID), decreasing = TRUE), 5)
cat_summary <- data.frame(
  Permit_Type = names(top_permit),
  Permit_Count = as.vector(top_permit),
  Structure_Type = names(top_structure),
  Structure_Count = as.vector(top_structure),
  Ward = names(top_ward),
  Ward_Count = as.vector(top_ward)
)
kable(cat_summary, caption = "Table 2. Top 5 categories of categorial predictors used in the model.")
```

## Fit Regression Model

```{r}
linear_reg <- lm(EST_CONST_COST ~ PERMIT_TYPE + STRUCTURE_TYPE + WARD_GRID +
                   DWELLING_UNITS_CREATED + RESIDENTIAL, data = cleaned_data)
# Extract key model statistics
r2 <- summary(linear_reg)$r.squared
adj_r2 <- summary(linear_reg)$adj.r.squared
f_stat <- summary(linear_reg)$fstatistic[1]
p_val <- pf(f_stat, summary(linear_reg)$fstatistic[2], summary(linear_reg)$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE)

cat("The model explains", round(r2, 3), "of the variance in construction cost (Adjusted R² =", round(adj_r2, 3), ").")
cat("The overall F-statistic is", round(f_stat, 1), "with a p-value <", signif(p_val, digits = 5), ", indicating the model is statistically significant.")
```

## Diagnostic Plots

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(linear_reg, caption = "Figure 1. Diagnostic plots for linear regression model.")
```
